name: Omamori: A MP100 Fangame
source:
You are a spirit haunting an omamori, a luck charm, who helps the people that receive it specifically with their struggles in love and romance.

And one day you're given to Reigen Arataka. He claims he doesn't need any help, he's fine, and isn't interested in someone. Every one of those things is a lie but can you help someone that won't admit they need it?

As you take your time observing this apparent conman while he works it becomes clear there is something there between him and his deputy director, Serizawa Katsuya, although neither one seem ready to confess. Get to know them and, with the aide of the people (and spirit?) in their lives, help them take that next step.

[From [url=https://novel-game-studios.itch.io/omamori-a-mp100-fangame]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个萦绕在御守身边的精灵，一个幸运符，专门帮助那些在爱情和浪漫中挣扎的人。

有一天，你被交给了Reigen Arataka。他声称他不需要任何帮助，他很好，并且对某人不感兴趣。这些事情中的每一件都是谎言，但你能帮助那些不承认自己需要它的人吗？

当你在这个明显的骗子工作时花时间观察他时，你会发现他和他的副主任芹泽克也之间存在着某种东西，尽管两人似乎都没有准备好坦白。了解他们，并在他们生活中的人（和精神？）的帮助下，帮助他们迈出下一步。

[来自[url=https://novel-game-studios.itch.io/omamori-a-mp100-fangame]itch.io[/url]]
